svg.text: Every numbered report was radioed in
and logged on one laptop at the
each one as it came in.
Report, numbered as in the radio log
Command post opens. Net open on primary.
Hiker, 19, overdue: down at dawn, one liter.
With the parents. Red pack, white sun hat.
MORNING · DOWN THE TRAIL AND ALONG THE RIM
Below-Rim starts down with extra water.
White sun hat just past the second tunnel.
1.5 Mile: a red pack seen heading down.
A different hiker, by the geology museum.
Hiker found at 3 Mile. Heat exhaustion.
Rim-East stands down at Mather Point.
Rim-West stands down at Hopi Point.
On scene at 3 Mile. Slow walk-out planned.
Parents reunited with the hiker, trailhead.
Mission backed up; 309 log printed for handoff.
People and events: RangerTrak’s fictional Grand Canyon demo.
